title: 1999 AMC 8 Problem 12
statement: The ratio of the number of games won to the number of games lost (no ties) by the Middle School Middies is \(\frac{11}{4}.\) To the nearest whole percent, what percent of its games did the team lose?

solutions.text:
The team can be viewed as winning \(11\) games and losing \(4\) games in each batch of \(15\) games.

The percent lost is \(\dfrac4{15}\cdot100\%\approx 27\%\).

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Use \(11\) wins and \(4\) losses as one batch
The lost fraction is losses over total games
